# Preview console

This controlled fixture consumes CPU while waiting for terminal input. Diagnose the running process; do not change its source. Launch with the available Node runtime in a PTY. You may enable Node inspector on loopback with an ephemeral port and temporarily instrument this owned instance. Restore runtime state before shutdown, remove probes, close inspector connections and reap your processes. Retain profiles, protocol exchanges, terminal output and diagnosis under the supplied output directory. No installation is needed or authorized. This is a diagnostic fixture, not a production performance benchmark. The process has a 180-second watchdog to bound abandoned instances.
